instruction: Set up the email account 'protonmail-user@protonmail.com' via ProtonMail Bridge in Thunderbird with password 'protonbridge999', and proceed to finish the configuration process no matter what login or connection notifications appear.

metadata.explanation: Variation 4: ProtonMail Bridge account setup task. User must configure both IMAP (127.0.0.1:1143) and SMTP (127.0.0.1:1025) servers with credentials protonmail-user@protonmail.com / protonbridge999. ProtonMail Bridge runs locally and provides IMAP/SMTP access via localhost ports. Evaluator uses firefox_decrypt.py to extract saved account credentials from Thunderbird profile and validates both incoming and outgoing mail server configurations are present. Same complexity as original task - requires multi-step account setup with both IMAP and SMTP configuration.
metadata.verification: Task validated against Thunderbird account setup process. ProtonMail Bridge uses local IMAP (127.0.0.1:1143) and SMTP (127.0.0.1:1025) servers with default ports. The check_csv metric will verify both mail server entries exist with correct credentials.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if both IMAP and SMTP accounts are configured correctly with specified credentials, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both required components: IMAP (127.0.0.1:1143) and SMTP (127.0.0.1:1025) account configurations
Uses appropriate extraction method: firefox_decrypt.py is the standard tool for extracting saved credentials from Thunderbird/Firefox profiles
check_csv metric correctly validates that all expected records (both IMAP and SMTP with correct user/password) are present in the CSV output
Expected values are semantically correct: URLs, usernames, and passwords match the instruction requirements
Postconfig properly executes credential extraction after task completion, ensuring Thunderbird has saved the account configurations
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies all aspects of the instruction (both mail servers with correct credentials)
